description: Macro indicators for any country from the World Bank (CC BY 4.0): GDP, GDP growth, GDP per capita, inflation (CPI), unemployment, population, current account, government debt and lending interest rate, with the year, value and unit of each. Country by ISO2 or ISO3 code or exact name; indicator by friendly name or a raw World Bank code. Values lag by one to two years; years with no published value are left out. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: ISO2 or ISO3 code (DE or DEU), or the country name, e.g. Germany

indicator.description: gdp, gdp-growth, gdp-per-capita, inflation, unemployment, population, current-account, government-debt, interest-rate, or a World Bank code such as NY.GDP.MKTP.CD

years.description: How many years back, 1 to 60, default 10

name: econ_indicator
title: Econ Indicator
